selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent sysctl policy, all live values at 0 before restart, and all values still at 0 afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Both pre- and post-change evidence show RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.

Captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, restart acknowledgement, temporary unavailability, changed boot ID, and full recovery with running system state, active services, restored networking, healthy filesystem, no failed units, and persistent hardening.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; cat /etc/redhat-release
uname -r
printf '%s\n' 'runtime:'
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
printf '%s\n' 'persistent matches:'
grep -RnsE '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' 'health:'
systemctl is-system-running || true
systemctl --failed --no-legend || true
findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /
df -P /

commands.command:
set -eu
